request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Sons born after the flood to Noah's line
Shem and Ham and Japheth stand in time
The sons of Japheth are named in the text
Gomer Magog Madai Javan next
Tubal Meshech and Tiras last of the seven
The youngest son in the genealogy given
[Chorus]
From these the coastland peoples spread out into their lands
Each with its own language by their clans within their nations
Be fruitful multiply and fill the earth
The fear and dread of you rest on the beast
[Verse]
The sons of Gomer Ashkenaz Riphath Togarmah
The sons of Javan Elishah Tarshish
Kittim and Dodanim in the list
Tiras remains in the record of the coast
[Chorus]
From these the coastland peoples spread out into their lands
Each with its own language by their clans within their nations
Be fruitful multiply and fill the earth
The fear and dread of you rest on the beast
[Bridge]
One Chronicles repeats the names of Japheth
Gomer Magog Madai Javan Tubal
Meshech and Tiras in the memory kept
The table of nations in the book
[Outro]
From them the whole earth was populated
Tiras part of the scattered nations
